feeding_claim.verbatim: 100% grass-fed and finished Black Angus beef

notes: Herd of about 50 Angus cattle raised from birth to finish on a farm near Shipshewana plus leased nearby pastures; the site gives no street address or exact town, so city is from 'near Shipshewana'. Read the homepage, how our beef is raised (our-impact), FAQ, shop and contact pages (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote). Our-impact says 'All our cattle are raised without the use of grain, growth hormones, chemicals, or GMO products' with hay in winter; FAQ says no corn or grain of any kind. Shop page: delivery for $35 within '4 Michiana local counties (Lagrange, Elkhart, Cass or St. Joseph)' (Cass County is likely the Michigan one), otherwise pickup at one of 2 farm locations near Shipshewana and Bristol; 'We are not able to ship any meat to you.' In-stock quarter and half beef available, custom whole steer sold out. Shop also sells chicken, duck and guinea eggs described as organic and free-range, but the site does not say the farm keeps the hens, so eggs are not listed as a species; the organic claim is the farm's own and was not checked. Email aroyal@pleasantmeadowfarm.net. The site is on a squarespace subdomain; pleasantmeadowfarm.net (from the email) was not checked.
